partner_result_applied.actual_use: For each fixed shared-environment value y, |A_y(t)|^2 <= pi L N/(|beta||t|); multiplied with the independent k-hub marginal Plancherel budget before any conditional slope density is formed.

new_claim.scope: R,V independent scalar sources with density caps L,N; U is a disjoint k>=2 physical cap-one product block; Y independent environment; ell(Y) has marginal R^k density cap K; arbitrary environment-dependent pair twists and arbitrary fixed within-U symmetric curvature; one scalar bilinear cross 2 beta R V.
new_claim.conclusion: With D=k+1 and a=LNK/|beta|, |phi_Q(t)|<=min(1,pi^(D/2)a^(1/2)|t|^(-D/2)); hence ||p_Q||inf<=D/(D-2)a^(1/D), P(Q in I)<=same*|I|, and p_Q is continuous C0. Also int |t|^-1/2|phi_Q|^2 <=[8D/(2D-1)]sqrt(pi)a^(1/(2D)).

strict_target_example: Q=2RV+2RY2+2VY1+2U1Y1+2U2Y2 on six independent cap-one inputs. Coefficient matrix is P6 adjacency with eigenvalues 2cos(j*pi/7), four having modulus >1. Bound ||p_Q||inf<=3; continuous C0.
unresolved_implication: Handle a general deterministic cross block in which the physical variables of the twisted bilinear pair also couple quadratically to the k-hub, destroying conditional factorization; seek operator-valued/iterated Plancherel before reciprocal coefficient payment, or a product-preserving structural routing to existing exits.
